## How do I connect my own mailbox?

Open Settings, choose Mailboxes, and connect a Google account or add SMTP details
directly. A connected mailbox must be verified before a campaign can send from it.

## Sending limits

A newly connected mailbox warms up gradually, so daily volume starts low and rises
over the first weeks.
